name: Geographic data readiness
description: Add a boundary join checklist and a map interpretation page.

steps.title: Geographic data QA
steps.markdown:
# Geographic data QA

Choose a stable area code. Reconcile matched and unmatched records and confirm that duplicate keys do not double-count the data. Record the coordinate system and boundary source.

steps.title: Map interpretation
steps.markdown:
# Map interpretation

Describe the mapped metric and denominator. Distinguish zero from missing data. Check whether the legend changes with filters before comparing colours across views.
